t: You're standing at the Peace Drinking Fountain, in the City of London. It was installed in 1873 as the centrepiece of Smithfield Rotunda Garden, which had been laid out the year before. Both the fountain and the garden are Grade II listed. At the centre is a bronze statue of Peace by John Birnie Philip, a nineteenth-century English sculptor who did much of his work for the architect Sir George Gilbert Scott. The structure was originally topped with a domed canopy in a Romanesque style.
